title: ULTRA HIKE Liechtenstein
description:
Long-distance hike in the Principality of Liechtenstein: 12-hour and 24-hour hike through the mountains of Liechtenstein

Welcome to the big 12h and 24h hike in the Principality of Liechtenstein! This unique tour starts at the heliport in the municipality of Balzers. The finish is on the outskirts of the main town of Vaduz at the stadium.
The varied route of the Ultra Hike Liechtenstein takes you through an impressive mountain world: from picturesque valleys to panoramic mountain trails to alpine peak panoramas. On your way you will experience a unique mix of nature, culture and sporting challenges - exactly what makes this hike so special.
The 12-hour hike is aimed at beginners and recreational hikers, while the 24-hour variant represents a challenge for well-trained amateur athletes. The adventurereich team provides drinks and food along the way to ensure that all participants reach their destination refreshed and safe. No matter whether you want to test your limits or just enjoy nature - this event offers the right challenge for everyone!
All information: https://www.erlebnisreich.de/tour/ultra-hike-liechtenstein-12-24h-wandel/

title: “Experience Vaduz” – Together at the LIHGA anniversary”
location:
Liechtenstein Marketing (Lageplan)
Im alten Riet
9494 Schaan
Fürstentum Liechtenstein, Vaduz
description:
The Vaduz Senior Citizens Commission invites the seniors from Vaduz to visit the LIHGA anniversary in Schaan together.

The Liechtenstein Industrial, Trade and Commercial Exhibition is celebrating its 25th edition this year. More than 200 exhibitors and partners present the diversity of the local and regional economy at the anniversary trade fair. In addition to numerous exhibition stands, there are various themed worlds and events to discover.

The meeting point for the joint arrival is at 1.55 p.m. at the Vaduz post office. Participants will receive their entry tickets there. At 2:03 p.m. the group will take the bus to Schaan, where a shuttle bus to the exhibition center will be available at 2:15 p.m. The bus trip is included in the offer. If you prefer to travel individually, you can join the group directly in Schaan and receive your entry ticket there.

At the start of the joint LIHGA visit, participants are invited to a fine Malbuner platter and drinks from 2:30 p.m. to 3:30 p.m. in the ARGUS Arena, which are offered by LIHGA partners. Entry to the fair is sponsored by the municipality of Vaduz. The seniors can then explore the anniversary LIHGA independently and plan their visit to the trade fair according to their own interests.

Registration: by Thursday, September 10, 2026, with Eleonora Nägele, senior representative, T +423 238 29 55, eleonora.naegele(at)vaduz.li

To register, we need your contact details as well as your home address. Please also let us know whether you are taking the shared bus ride from Vaduz or joining the group directly in Schaan.

As part of “Experience Vaduz”, the Vaduz Senior Citizens Commission organizes visits for Vaduz seniors three times in the spring and three times in the autumn. The events are free and take place in all weather conditions.
